name: AutoDock Vina

steps: Choose the maintainer's Vina Windows executable matching the host architecture from the official release page.
Record the release URL and SHA-256 digest before downloading or running it; do not infer a filename or bypass release verification.
Place the executable in a user-owned directory and invoke it with --help. Do not assume installing the Python bindings also installs the executable.
manual_fallback.verify_note: Run the exact downloaded Vina executable with --help and record its path, release tag, and digest.

notes: The upstream guide treats precompiled executables and pip-installed Python bindings separately. The reviewed conda-forge vina build installs both the vina and vina_split executables and Python bindings on Linux/macOS; Windows users need a separate manual route.
Docking inputs still need suitable ligand/receptor preparation, which this recipe does not perform.
